# aidial_alias (Data Source)

Reads an existing alias stored in DIAL Core resource storage without managing it. Use `aidial_file_alias` for aliases defined in static (file) configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An alias stored in DIAL Core resource storage, for example one managed
# elsewhere with the aidial_alias resource.
data "aidial_alias" "fast_chat" {
  bucket = "public"
  path   = "fast-chat"
}

output "alias_target" {
  value = data.aidial_alias.fast_chat.target_path
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) DIAL bucket. Must be "public" or "platform".
- `path` (String) Alias path inside the bucket.

### Read-Only

- `api_name` (String) Canonical alias name returned by the DIAL API.
- `description` (String) Alias description.
- `description_keywords` (Set of String) Keywords that help find the alias by description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable alias name.
- `display_version` (String) Version shown for the alias.
- `icon_url` (String) URL of the alias icon.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the form <bucket>/<path>.
- `intro` (String) Introductory text shown for the alias.
- `name` (String) Alias name returned by the DIAL API.
- `present_as` (String) What the alias is shown as: `model`, `application` or `toolset`.
- `target_path` (String) The deployment the alias points at: `models/<name>`, `applications/<name>` or `toolsets/<name>`.
- `user_roles` (Set of String) Roles allowed to use the alias.
